hook: Ellsworth graduated early from Stanford with a B.S. in Computer Science with Distinction, worked as a research engineer at Google DeepMind, and now leads initiatives related to search and agents as a Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI. He was a U.S. Presidential Scholar and a USA Biology Olympiad national finalist.
